verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a management or automation API, and nothing shows API parity with the UI for cases, SLOs, rules, dashboards, or Fleet. The only API-adjacent items are an ingest endpoint and ES|QL querying, which are data-plane features rather than full UI-equivalent API coverage. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
